description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm_costs'. It includes parsing of currency strings, optional filtering by tenant, project, and date range, and merges data from multiple sources to produce a summarized report.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: Parses currency-like strings and other inputs safely into numbers, returning 0 for invalid inputs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main function that aggregates agent costs and usage from MongoDB collections with filtering and merging logic.
